name: tpl-precedence-1-nogoal
task: If you reach the exit, you must have flipped the switch first.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The clause states `RespondedExistence(switch_toggled, at_exit)`, meaning if the switch is toggled then the exit must also be reached. The task, however, requires the opposite: reaching the exit implies that the switch has already been toggled. The correct rule is a hard `Precedence(switch_toggled, at_exit)` (or equivalently a hard `RespondedExistence(at_exit, switch_toggled)` with the order reversed). Replace the clause with this proper ordering so that the reward machine enforces that the switch is toggled before the exit is reached.

texts: If you reach the exit, you must have flipped the switch first
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2

FINAL_STATES:
REJECTING_STATES: u2

(u0, !at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u1
(u0, at_exit&!switch_toggled) -> u2
(u0, at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u1
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, at_exit&!switch_toggled, u2) -> -10
